summary: Closed GC publication race and immutable TMUX identity race for terminal worker stale cleanup
risks: Synthetic stale RESULT uses no-replace publish; STATUS still overwrites non-terminal values — worker must publish RESULT first for typed runs to win races reliably
worker_tmux_id is captured at mark_stale; if TMUX session is replaced before grace elapses, stop may target a session that already exited (harmless no-op via kill-session)
resolveRunState now allows synthetic worker_stale_timeout failed STATE to upgrade to done/cancelled; ordinary terminal irreversibility is unchanged for non-synthetic failures
